rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for introducing a concessive clause.

example.english: Although it's raining, I still have to go to work.
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1

rows.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 A daan6 hai6 B
rows.note: Use this common spoken pattern when you want to link both the concessive clause and the contrasting main clause explicitly.

example.english: Although it's very cold today, we still have to go jogging.
example.traditional: 雖然今日好凍，但係我哋都要去跑步。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 paau2 bou6

rows.note: Choose this mainly in formal or written contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: Although the weather was bad, the project was completed on schedule.
example.traditional: 儘管天氣惡劣，工程仍然如期完成。
example.jyutping: zeon6 gun2 tin1 hei3 ngok3 lyut6 gung1 cing4 jing4 jin4 jyu4 kei4 jyun4 sing4
